name: inAir
author: priard
description: Air quality anywhere in the world on your bar: Open-Meteo everywhere, Sensor.Community street sensors, and GIOŚ and InPost in Poland, with weather, a place search and a first-run wizard. Unofficial; not affiliated with any data provider.

barWidget.description: PM2.5 pill coloured by the air quality index, from the source you choose; switch between the four with 1–4 in the panel.

schema.label: Pinned InPost locker code (empty = nearest with a sensor)
Index scale: polish or european (empty = polish for GIOŚ and InPost, european otherwise)
